item.title: Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas Advises Vixar on Share Acquisition in The Belgian Waffle Co.
item.description: Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas advised Vixar on its acquisition of a shareholding in Bloombay Enterprises Private Limited, which operates The Belgian Waffle Co., one of India’s leading dessert-focused QSR brands with over 700 outlets across 250 cities. The post Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas Advises Vixar on Share Acquisition in The Belgian Waffle Co. appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Delhi High Court passes John Doe order protecting Andhra Pradesh Deputy CM Pawan Kalyan’s Personality Rights
item.description: The grievance of the plaintiff arose from the manufacture, sale, promotion, and distribution of merchandise such as T-shirts, posters, mugs, keychains, and other products bearing his name, photographs, likeness, and persona, without authorisation. The post Delhi High Court passes John Doe order protecting Andhra Pradesh Deputy CM Pawan Kalyan’s Personality Rights appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: MeitY Advisory to Social Media Platforms on Unlawful Online Content: Compliance Under IT Act & Rules
item.description: MeitY has issued an advisory directing intermediaries and social media platforms to prevent hosting, sharing, or transmission of obscene, indecent, sexually explicit, paedophilic, or otherwise unlawful online content; directing to remove them within 24 hours.
